name: Crash Doctor
description: After a crash, shows where it happened, what most likely went wrong and what you did before

issues.info: Report bugs on GitHub or in the Discord server

show-report.name: Show the report
show-report.description: After a crash, the report shows over the main menu at the next start. Off: it's only written to the log

report-detail.name: Report detail
report-detail.description: Auto: the whole report (the line, the code, the stack) when the crashed mod has its PDB on this computer, which is how a mod's developer has it; for everyone else, which mod it was and what to do, with the details a button away

language.name: Language
language.description: The report's language. Auto: Russian on a Russian Windows, English otherwise
